scope: Educational organ/system knowledge boundary for Body Exposure. This dataset is not patient-specific anatomy, diagnosis, treatment advice, prescribing guidance, clinical validation, or evidence of human review.

claims.content: Kidneys connect to the urinary bladder through the ureters; urine exits the bladder through the urethra.
Renal function includes filtration followed by tubular handling of water and solutes, supporting fluid, electrolyte and acid-base homeostasis.
Disease-state overlays may connect altered filtration, tubular handling, urinary flow or tissue injury to educational explanations only after the specific relationship is source-verified.
Drug overlays must identify the relevant renal or urinary target/mechanism and must not imply an individualized indication, dose, efficacy or safety conclusion.
Imaging overlays must distinguish educational modality/anatomy relationships from interpretation of a patient's study and must not infer pathology from atlas geometry.
